definitions: On every side of (something so as to encircle or enclose it).
Located or situated on every side of.
So as to encircle or enclose.
In or to many places throughout (an area or place).
From one side to the other of (a point or line).
So as to face in a different direction.
So as to be available or present.
examples: The children sat around the table.
There's a fence around the garden.
The shop is around the corner.
The car spun around the corner.
He's been around for a while.
